mechanism: Both drugs prolong QT interval and inhibit cardiac potassium channels; amiodarone inhibits CYP3A4 increasing chloroquine levels, and both accumulate in tissues with potential for additive cardiotoxicity.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if necessary, obtain baseline ECG, monitor QTc interval closely, reduce chloroquine dose, and check electrolytes (K+, Mg2+) regularly.
